packageRules.description: Major updates one at a time
GitHub Actions digest pinning; action majors are grouped deliberately (cheap to revert, low risk)

The Rust toolchain is hand-maintained (rust-toolchain.toml is the source of truth); Renovate must not bump the dtolnay/rust-toolchain toolchain input, which would desynchronize release/publish from CI
Delay cargo updates (majors and lockfile-maintenance included — a fresh crate is the least-reviewed entry in a lockfile) to shrink the freshly-published-crate supply-chain window
